text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Oguri Cap is standing on the academy
rooftop,
gazing into the distance.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I was just thinking about my hometown. I
wonder
how everyone is doing...
choice_data_list: What were you doing in a place like this?
What were you doing in a place like this?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... That cloud kind of looks like
Shige.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: And that one reminds me of Tome. And that one over there... meat stew... Sigh...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Oguri Cap doesn't seem like herself
today. I guess
she's homesick.
